summary: One church, Immaculate Conception, Montclair. Weekend Masses (Sat 5 PM; Sun 8, 10:30, 6 PM) and Saturday 4:30 PM Confession agree in both bulletins (Nov 8, Nov 15) and the website. Open: the Mon-Fri noon Mass in Pope Francis Hall, below the parish office at 1 Munn St (different address from the church).
